[USER] User asked for advice on how to prevent nail infections.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Maintain good hygiene: Keep nails clean and dry; wash hands regularly with soap and water.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Avoid sharing personal items such as towels, socks, or shoes that come in contact with feet or nails.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Wear protective footwear in public showers or locker rooms.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Avoid tight footwear to prevent a moist environment conducive to fungal growth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trim nails regularly to prevent debris accumulation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Use antifungal products like powders or sprays on feet and in shoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Eat a healthy diet to boost the immune system and prevent fungal infections.
